caption: Overview of the evaluation framework and guidelines for users.
notes: Evaluation summary is reproducible; decision framework remains reference-only. Noise updates modify only six noise F1 columns, while boundary metrics are refreshed separately from the latest Figure3 results. Plot geometry and row order follow Figure5(summary).ipynb.

dropdown_edge.statistic: Mean signed raw ligand-count difference across the 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80% edge-dropout results; no tool-size normalization is applied.
dropdown_edge.interpretation: A larger positive value means more ligand calls were lost on average. A negative value means the perturbed result contained more calls. Values are scale-dependent across tools.

equal_edge.statistic: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov D statistic comparing original and edge-equalized ligand-count distributions.
equal_edge.interpretation: D = max_x |F_original(x) - F_equalized(x)| and 0 <= D <= 1. Larger values indicate a stronger distribution shift; D does not encode the direction of change.

gradient_edge.statistic: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov D statistic comparing original and gradient-changed ligand-count distributions.
gradient_edge.interpretation: D = max_x |F_original(x) - F_gradient(x)| and 0 <= D <= 1. Larger values indicate a stronger distribution shift; D does not encode the direction of change.
